title: Shri Renukadevi Mahatme
desc: Renuka Devi falls for a sage named Jamadagni and gets married to him, leaving all the worldly possessions. Years later, when she daydreams of a materialistic life, the sage curses her.

title: Avane Srimannarayana
desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

title: Taarak
desc: An aspiring journalist is recruited by a popular newspaper to write weekly articles aimed at inspiring college students.

title: Odahuttidavaru
desc: Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.

title: Return Of The Dragon
desc: Reeling from a sad breakup, a college student gives up on his studies to commit financial fraud. However, his new endeavour puts him in a difficult spot.
